verdict.rationale: Modal documents programmatic sandbox creation with custom images and volumes ([modal-docs-2], [modal-docs-20]) and command execution via `sb.exec` ([modal-docs-21], [modal-docs-25]). Results can be read through process output, filesystem access and the logs API ([modal-docs-8], [modal-docs-23]), and an official agent example runs agent-generated code in a Sandbox ([modal-docs-22], [modal-docs-30]). A community developer also reports controlling Modal Sandboxes from an agent runtime ([modal-comm-2]). Missing for 10: an explicitly documented terminate/teardown call (only implied by 'ephemeral'), and independent hands-on corroboration of the full provision-exec-read-teardown loop running unattended.
